title: A customer question about Installing the Desktop Client

question.author: member_048
question.body: I need a short answer about installing the desktop client. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Desktop Client documentation says: After installation, sign in and choose which folders to sync; the default is your entire CloudBox folder with selective sync available for fine control. Download the desktop client from the CloudBox download page. Supported platforms: Windows 10 or newer, macOS 11 or newer, and Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+ / Fedora 36+, via .deb package or AppImage — available since CloudBox 2.0). That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
